# Smart Learning — Frontend LMS Prototype

## Run it
1. Extract the ZIP.
2. Open `index.html` in a modern browser. For best results, use VS Code Live Server.
3. Register a student account or use one of the demo accounts below.

## Demo accounts
- Student: `student@smart.lk` / `student123`
- Teacher: `teacher@smart.lk` / `teacher123`
- Admin: `admin@smart.lk` / `admin123`

## Included
Responsive landing page, registration/login, student dashboard, course catalogue and filtering, classroom lesson navigation, study material filtering and sample downloads, timed auto-marked quiz, live class schedule, assignment file selection, profile editing, admin overview, teacher workspace, dark mode and localStorage persistence.

## Important prototype limitations
This is a browser-only frontend prototype. Authentication is demo-grade and passwords are stored in localStorage; do not use real personal data. File uploads, video playback, live meeting links, teacher/admin management, notifications, and real course/material records require a secure backend, database, file storage and service integrations. Sample material downloads are `.txt` demo files rather than official PDFs.
